title: AgentIndex
description:
The `GET /agent` index: which server answered, which build, and the topics
it serves.

build.description: Human-readable build label, e.g. `reflex 0.1.0`. Informative only.

describe_only.description:
Always `true`: nothing under `/agent` changes state. A consumer that
reads `false` trusts nothing else in the body. `const: true` in the
schema, so a conformance check refuses `false`.

git_sha.description:
The full 40-hex lowercase commit the binary was built from, embedded
at build time. **Absent when unknown** — never `null`, never `""`,
never a guess (spec §2); a consumer reads absence as "build unknown".

topics.description:
The six common topics first, in spec §3 order, then any
server-specific ones.

href.description: Where the topic is served, e.g. `/agent/setup`.

summary.description: One sentence, for an index or a tool description.
